kardashian.take: She and the tabloid lady have the same face and I'm supposed to believe that's a coincidence? Please.

maura-higgins.take: She sets her lineup before the kettle boils and still beats me some weeks — that's not skill, that's the universe laughing at me personally.

panics and copy-flips his own lineup if Maura posts a last-minute swap before kickoff, even against his own projections
